messages:
Riya Banerjee: Hi all 3 I'm Riya, starting today on Eng-ML. Remote on EST. Quick Qs: how do I get VPN & MDM set up? Who do I ask for access to the 'inference-staging' GCP project? Also, fun fact: I make pickled mangoes. Two truths & a lie: rowed varsity in college, speak 4 languages, hate sushi. :wave:
Juno (Onboarding): Welcome Riya! Onboarding checklist emailed. Steps: 1) Okta invite -> accept. 2) MDM enrollment link in the email (use corporate laptop serial). 3) WireGuard config will be auto-provisioned after MDM. If anything times out, reply here.
IT Help: Hi Riya 3 your laptop (asset R-9876) is shipping. For MDM: open the "Company MDM" app, enter code 842913. If you see the macOS error "Profile installation failed", run `sudo profiles renew -type enrollment` then reboot. VPN: run `brew install wireguard-tools` then import the config attached to your email.
DevX Bot: account-created: GitHub invite sent. Slack: added to #eng-ml and #new-hires. Calendar: 1:1 with Priya scheduled.
Priya Rao: Hey Riya 3 I'm your onboarding buddy. For GCP access, file an infra ticket at https://intranet.redwood/infra-request with project id `inference-staging` and tag Marcus. For quick permissions, request role `roles/viewer` first. Also we do a weekly "new hires show-and-tell" on Fridays, you should join.
Riya Banerjee: Thanks! One more: how do I request a second monitor and headphones? Also who to ping about running the local tiny-model?
Marcus Li: I can grant project access once ticket's created. For hardware, use https://intranet.redwood/equipment-request -> select "peripherals" and choose "new hire" priority. Local tiny-model: clone `git@github.com:redwood/inference-starter.git` then `make run-local MODEL=redwood-mini`. If you hit CUDA errors, try `export TORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=max_split_size_mb:128` before running.
IT Help: If MDM fails on MacOS Big Sur, send us the console log snippet. For WireGuard status use `wg show` and paste output (we'll redact IPs).
Riya Banerjee: Got it, thank you everyone! Intro for #general coming shortly 3 fun fact for that channel: pickled mangoes + terrible at sushi may both be lies. :pickle: :boat:
